descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Asociat
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Who We Are
 We are seeking an experienced QA Lead to lead the implementation of the quality strategy across a complex programme. In this role, you will act as the technical quality reference for multiple delivery teams, ensuring that established standards, processes, metrics, and automation practices are consistently applied across all deliverables.
Working closely with the Project Manager, Product Owners, technical teams, and external partners, you will define the automation and continuous quality roadmap, strengthen quality governance, and drive the adoption of Shift-Left, Quality by Design, and continuous improvement practices throughout the software delivery lifecycle.
 What You'll Be Doing
Implement and continuously improve the programme’s quality and testing strategy
Design and maintain the automation and continuous quality roadmap
Act as the QA technical reference across multiple teams and delivery streams
Oversee functional, API, end-to-end, and automated test coverage
Review and validate test plans, test cases, test results, and supporting evidence
Define quality KPIs, metrics, dashboards, and governance processes
Coordinate testing activities across internal teams, external vendors, and stakeholders
Promote Shift-Left, Quality by Design, and risk-based testing practices
Identify quality risks, dependencies, and gaps, and define appropriate mitigation plans
Advise Product Owners, project stakeholders, and technical teams on quality-related decisions
Drive continuous improvement initiatives across testing processes, tools, and ways of working
Ensure automation solutions are effectively integrated into CI/CD pipelines
 What you'll bring along 
More than seven years of experience in Quality Assurance and Quality Engineering
Proven experience implementing testing and quality strategies across complex programmes
Strong knowledge of functional test automation, API testing, and end-to-end testing
Hands-on experience with tools such as Playwright, Postman, GitLab, or similar technologies
Experience with test and delivery management tools such as Jira, Confluence, and Xray
Strong understanding of Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment practices
Experience working within Agile delivery environments
Ability to define quality metrics, KPIs, dashboards, and governance models
Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and decision-making capabilities
Excellent problem-solving and executive and technical communication skills
English language proficiency at B2–C1 level
Experience with cloud architectures, microservices, or multinational programmes would be advantageous
ISTQB Advanced Test Manager certification or an equivalent qualification would be considered an advantage
